criteria.text: A latest native chat question, change request, "I approve" or queued message alone never passes any gate; an agent approval call without --said refuses, asks the agent to ask me and use --said, and reads no approval evidence.

At each story, PR-opening and code-or-stop gate, any nonblank --said words such as "looks good" or "ship it" are accepted without grading their meaning; empty words refuse and strict mode requires a person terminal.
A person terminal keeps y/N, with no approval or advance on decline; no chat arrival, step, done or status crosses an approval gate without an explicit approve call.
A workflow without an approve boundary before code shows an advisory and remains usable, including a valid custom single-area PR workflow.

cases.given: every gate; agent/nonTTY/current Herdr pane; latest question, change, I approve and queued text
cases.required_observation: exit 1; ask person then --said; evidence-reader calls 0; no state/prompt/journal/Git/PR/chat-start effects

cases.given: every gate; said looks good, ship it, This works, what about X?
cases.required_observation: ready gate accepts every nonblank string verbatim; no lexical or semantic grading

cases.given: empty/whitespace said; strict true with nonblank said
cases.required_observation: refuse without side effects, no fallback; strict requests person terminal

cases.given: no said; unmarked person TTY y then separate fresh gate n
cases.required_observation: existing confirmation retained; y approves, n preserves waiting gate and decisions; may pass base

cases.given: gate waiting; inject user chat, repeat last done, read status
cases.required_observation: no approval/next area before approve call; may pass base

cases.given: valid project custom single-area workflow with one build step and gate pr; list and start
cases.required_observation: advisory names workflow and no approve gate before code; valid shape retained, startup succeeds; no injected gate

cases.given: approve or before approve boundary, or ask-code boundary before following area
cases.required_observation: no missing-gate advisory; original workflow shape retained
